coinbase_strategy.interpretation: Coinbase is positioning as a multi-product distribution, custody, spot/derivatives, stablecoin, lending, payments and prediction-markets platform. RLUSD listing expands its stablecoin slate; the material USDC economics show that this is not evidence Circle was displaced.

circle_and_sbi_context.circle_usdc_xrpl: Native USDC support on XRPL is an existing direct Circle/XRPL relationship.
circle_and_sbi_context.circle_coinbase: Circle's Q2 2026 filing and Coinbase's Q3 2026 filing document material USDC distribution economics; Coinbase reported $22B average USDC held in products during Q3 and said its Circle arrangement renewed on the same terms.
circle_and_sbi_context.circle_arc: Circle's Arc launch identifies SBI Group as a founding validator, Coinbase as an exchange-access partner and Morpho as a credit-layer participant. Arc is a distinct network, not XRPL.
circle_and_sbi_context.sbi: SBI has separate XRP/XRPL, Circle SBI Japan, Arc and JPYSC relationships. No direct BNY-SBI or Robinhood-SBI contract is established by this snapshot.
circle_and_sbi_context.sbic: Tokyo SBIC is a separate SME investment corporation, not SBI Holdings; no XRP relationship is inferred.

relationship_hypotheses.statement: BNY's support for XRP custody increases institutional access and lowers custody friction.
disconfirming_or_alternative: No XRP AUC or client balance disclosed.
A custody capability can exist with low or zero client utilization.

relationship_hypotheses.statement: Robinhood's announced RLUSD institutional settlement on XRPL may expand XRPL stablecoin settlement activity.
disconfirming_or_alternative: RLUSD settlement may occur without XRP as bridge asset.
No volume, counterparty or XRP inventory disclosure.

relationship_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase is expanding as a multi-stablecoin distribution platform rather than replacing Circle USDC with RLUSD.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Future changes to distribution economics or product allocation could alter the mix.
No current RLUSD versus USDC net-flow split disclosed.

relationship_hypotheses.statement: BNY custody, Robinhood settlement/treasury and Coinbase distribution form complementary institutional rails around Ripple assets.
disconfirming_or_alternative: No joint operating agreement or shared capital plan disclosed.

relationship_hypotheses.statement: BNY XRP custody and Coinbase/Morpho collateral channels could improve institutional XRP utility.
disconfirming_or_alternative: No XRP collateral balances, borrowing utilization or custody AUC disclosed.
Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral support is not live at launch and is not XRP collateral.
Morpho cbXRP and Coinbase derivatives collateral are separate systems.

relationship_hypotheses.statement: Growth in RLUSD settlement on XRPL may increase ledger use without materially increasing XRP demand.
disconfirming_or_alternative: If actual settlement requires substantial XRP bridge inventory or creates material liquidity demand, the effect could be larger.
No bridge-asset or XRP inventory data disclosed.
